subject.title: Feature: Global session reset on auth switch

question: Should OpenClaw support an admin-only global auth refresh, and if so should it override explicit session auth-profile pins and interrupt active runs or defer them until the next safe turn boundary?
rationale: Current code separates durable auth pins, CLI auth epochs, active-run admission, credential resolution, and destructive reset behavior; their precedence and security semantics cannot be selected mechanically.

options.title: Safe-boundary global refresh
options.body: Refresh unpinned idle sessions immediately, defer active sessions, preserve identity and transcripts, and report pinned or failed sessions.

options.title: Destructive reset-all
options.body: Expose a clearly destructive admin operation that rotates every session and accepts runtime and context discontinuity.

options.title: Keep per-session controls
options.body: Decline a global operation and document credential reload plus per-session soft reset as the supported model.

recommendation.title: Safe-boundary global refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh unpinned idle sessions immediately, defer active sessions, preserve identity and transcripts, and report pinned or failed sessions.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history and prior review connect this person to Gateway reset and session lifecycle decisions.
